title: Origin story: Medusa
description: Medusa was once a beautiful maiden, a priestess of Athena, transformed into a Gorgon with serpents for hair after Poseidon violated her in Athena's temple — punished by the goddess for the desecration. Her gaze turned any living thing to stone, and she dwelt with her immortal sisters Stheno and Euryale at the world's edge.

title: Power ranking: Medusa

title: Stamina feats: Medusa
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Guarded her lair alone against generations of attackers; Her power persisted in her severed head indefinitely.

title: Crossover notes: Medusa

title: Cultural impact: Medusa
